summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the Table 1/Table 3 activity gap, preserved DBAASP strain/endpoint conflicts and KW-23 modification caveats, and closed the prior complete-message rework ticket with publication-grade acceptance carrying explicit cautions.
adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review completed from local XML/PDF/database materials; accepted_with_cautions because conflicts are preserved rather than normalized.

caution_findings.note: Merged DBAASP sequence row gives KWKWKW, while the primary paper describes KW-23 as a ferulic-acid-conjugated K/W hexapeptide with MW 1136.34 Da; the unmodified sequence string is not treated as the full construct.
DBAASP rows naming ATCC MYA-573 conflict with primary ATCC MYA-574, and one database MBC endpoint conflicts with the primary fungal MFC endpoint.
The resistant-strain fluconazole MIC differs between Table-1 and Table-2; both source-located comparator values are preserved without using them to alter KW-23 rows.
The two local supplementary assets are unrelated Veterinary World HTML pages; no true local supplement table was available or required for the repaired evidence.
The paper supports design rationale, phenotypic antifungal/synergy, and hemolysis context but not a direct molecular target or direct Candida membrane assay.
